KESHAV BHARADWAJ

📞 +91 8861589051 | ✉ keshav.bharadwaj10@gmail.com 📍 Bangalore, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Dynamic and results-driven Finance & Business Operations Leader with over 10 years of experience in managing end-to-end financial processes, project management, and cross-functional team leadership. Proven expertise in orchestrating large-scale transitions, optimizing operational workflows, and enhancing stakeholder satisfaction. Adept at coordinating complex projects, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining high-quality standards in fast-paced, global environments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Project Management & Implementation | Client Onboarding & Coordination | Process Optimization & Automation | Cross-functional Team Leadership | Stakeholder Engagement & Communication | Financial Reporting & Analysis | ERP Systems (SAP) & Power BI | SLA & KPI Management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Lead – Finance & Business Operations Continuserve – Quatrro Business Solutions | July 2017 – March 2025 ● Spearheaded transition of financial operations for a North American logistics client, ensuring seamless onboarding and

delivery.

Developed and implemented SOPs, KPIs, RCAs, and SLAs, reducing monthly operational costs by 50%. ● Scaled team from 4 to 120+ FTEs across finance operations; improved AHT from 8 mins to 5.4 mins. ● Created executive dashboards and MIS reports for budget tracking, variance analysis, and stakeholder reporting. ● Managed US/EU order processing lifecycle; implemented software improvements to enhance billing accuracy. Process Associate Altisource Business Solutions | June 2014 – June 2017 ● Managed mortgage process escalations and ensured compliance with insurance disbursement policies. ● Provided live support and training to new team members, including audit resolution and quality assurance.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce Monad University | 2013

AWARDS & RECOGNITION

Above & Beyond Award – Q3 & Q4 2023, Q4 2024 – For exceeding performance goals and leading in-house application

development.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

ERP Systems: SAP | Data Visualization: Power BI | Productivity Tools: Microsoft Excel (Advanced), SharePoint | Custom ERP Systems
